description: Fork of exp104 (TinyMultiHeadLut sparse_scatter mode) doubling n_sparse_outputs from 8 to 16 for all three LUT modules (qk_joint, v_lut, out_proj). Per-table weights double; coverage per output slot doubles (e.g. out_proj: 16*2048/E=384 ~ 85 tables/slot vs 42). Other settings match exp104: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, nap=8, qk/v tph=384, out tph=2048, classic skip residual, linear unembedder.
